author: Iron
body:
Welp as some fanboys may know. *Cough* Dylan *Cough* Destiny: The Taken King came out recently. Some see it as the one of the largest improvements to a game ever. And to be honest, it really is. For one, it's finally let me distance myself from MINECRAFT PVPPVPPQPP!P!!!!!! Anywho, what are your opinions on it if you have it? I know Avicus has a small destiny community soooo yeah. 

I personally think it's great banter.

EDIT: What should I do with my name? It's some great banter.
